name_note: Genomes GTDB places in Thomasclavelia are also deposited under the older names Coprobacillus and Clostridium.

sentences.text: Thomasclavelia is a genus proposed for four species formerly classified in Clostridium: Clostridium cocleatum, Clostridium ramosum, Clostridium spiroforme and Clostridium saccharogumia.
These species form a cluster in the family Coprobacillaceae within the order Erysipelotrichales, and Thomasclavelia ramosa is the type species of the genus.

A case-control study using 16S rRNA sequencing and culturomics for gut microbiome profiling reported Thomasclavelia ramosa significantly increased in alcohol-related liver disease with hepatocellular carcinoma.
Thomasclavelia ramosa makes an immunoglobulin A protease, one of a group of enzymes secreted by bacteria that inhabit human mucosal tissues.
